title: August and the Hymn
author: Emrys Eriksen
blurb: Kestrel Amberdale, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
